description: POST /report-links — create a shareable report link (snapshot or live with cadence).

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

cadence.description: Required for live mode; update frequency

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format

mode.description: snapshot for static link, live for auto-updating

password.description: Optional password to protect the share link

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

report_id.description: UUID of the report to share

template_id.description: Optional report template to use for rendering

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_report_link
